emcCenterCenterTextAlign: Enum constant for center-center text alignment in pyAether. Used as alignment parameter in text display APIs like emyAttrDisplay.create.
emcCenterLeftTextAlign: Enum constant for center-left text alignment in pyAether. Used as alignment parameter in text display APIs.
emcCenterRightTextAlign: Enum constant for center-right text alignment in pyAether. Used as alignment parameter in text display APIs.
emcLowerLeftTextAlign: Enum constant for lower-left text alignment in pyAether. Used as alignment parameter in text display APIs.
emcUpperLeftTextAlign: Enum constant for upper-left text alignment in pyAether. Used as alignment parameter in text display APIs.
emcGroundSigType: Enum constant for ground signal type in pyAether. Used to classify signal types in net/terminal APIs.
emcPowerSigType: Enum constant for power signal type in pyAether. Used to classify signal types in net/terminal APIs.
emcInheritFromTopBlock: Enum constant for inheritance from top block in pyAether. Used in design hierarchy configuration.
emcMY: Enum constant for mirror-Y orientation in pyAether. Used in transform/orientation APIs.
emcNonePlacementStatus: Enum constant for none placement status in pyAether. Used in instance placement status checks.
emcSchematicSymbol: Enum constant for schematic symbol type in pyAether. Used in cell view type classification.
emcStickFont: Enum constant for stick font type in pyAether. Used in text display font selection.
emcValueTextDisplayFormat: Enum constant for value text display format in pyAether. Used in attribute display format selection.
aeBaseAppFormCallBack: Callback type for application form events in pyAether. Used in aeCreateAppForm to handle form interactions.
aeMenuItemCallBack: Callback type for menu item events in pyAether. Used in aeCreateMenuItem to handle menu selections.
aeCrtHBoxLayout: Function to create a horizontal box layout in pyAether GUI. Used in application form layout construction.
dbCV: Alias for database cell view operations in pyAether. Related to dbCVExist, dbCVIsLocked. May refer to the current cell view object.
dbInst: Alias for database instance operations in pyAether. Related to dbInstanceQuery, dbInstanceQueryByCb.
dmGetObj.files: Property to get files from a dmGetObj (design management object) in pyAether. Returns file list associated with the DM object.
CString.value: Property to access the string value of a CString object in pyAether. CString is a C-style string wrapper.
CStringList.at: Method to access element at index in a CStringList (string array) in pyAether. Returns the string at the specified position.
GuCartPolyLine.getLinePattern: Method to get the line pattern of a GuCartPolyLine (cartesian polyline) in pyAether. Returns the pattern enum value.
GuCartPolyLine.getLineWidth: Method to get the line width of a GuCartPolyLine in pyAether. Returns the width value.
GuCartPolyLine.setLinePattern: Method to set the line pattern of a GuCartPolyLine in pyAether. Takes a pattern enum value parameter.
GuCartPolyLine.setLineWidth: Method to set the line width of a GuCartPolyLine in pyAether. Takes a width value parameter.
MdePlatDonauJobPolicy.setMaxJobNum: Method to set max job number for Donau job policy in pyAether. Used in simulation job scheduling.
MdePlatLSFJobPolicy.setMaxJobNum: Method to set max job number for LSF job policy in pyAether. Used in simulation job scheduling.
MdePlatOGEJobPolicy.setMaxJobNum: Method to set max job number for OGE job policy in pyAether. Used in simulation job scheduling.
MdeSpeOutput.plot: Property to set/get plot flag for MdeSpeOutput (spectral output) in pyAether. Controls whether output is plotted.
MdeSpeOutput.save: Property to set/get save flag for MdeSpeOutput in pyAether. Controls whether output is saved to file.
MdeSweepType.stepMode: Property to get/set step mode for MdeSweepType in pyAether. Controls sweep stepping behavior (linear, logarithmic, etc.).
emyBlock.create: Static method to create an emyBlock object in pyAether. Blocks are design hierarchy containers.
emyPointArray.append: Method to append a point to emyPointArray (integer point array) in pyAether. Used in polygon/path construction.
emyPointArrayF.append: Method to append a point to emyPointArrayF (float point array) in pyAether. Used in precise geometric construction.
emyRect.addToPin: Method to add a rectangle to a pin in pyAether. Used in pin geometry construction for layout design.
emyStringArray.append: Method to append a string to emyStringArray in pyAether. Used in string list construction for various APIs.
